items.alt: Hologram Scanner & 3D Radar Suite: LiDAR, Pulse Scanner & Holo-Twin
items.title: Hologram Scanner & 3D Radar Suite: LiDAR, Pulse Scanner & Holo-Twin
items.desc: AAA in-world holographic radars, LiDAR scanners & vehicle holo-twins for Unreal Engine 5. Built for sci-fi cockpits, mech combat, space simulators, and open-world games.

items.alt: AFC Ajax Hackathon — Real-Time 3D Tracking & VR Simulation
items.title: AFC Ajax Hackathon — Real-Time 3D Tracking & VR Simulation
items.desc: 1st Place Rockstars Impact Award winner (~200 developers, 24 teams at Johan Cruyff ArenA). Real-time 3D sports telemetry and first-person VR match simulation engine in Unity ingesting Ajax's 21-point skeletal tracking data.

items.title: Sniper's Ground: VR Multiplayer Sniping Game
items.desc: Sniper's Ground is a PC VR multiplayer sniping stealth shooting game with a day and night cycle, high graphics and voice chat.

items.title: Relaxing In VR Experiences
items.desc: Multiplayer VR relaxation environments and spatial audio scenes built for the Homaysa Steam VR platform, featuring interactive desert starlight camps and tranquil social spaces with spatial voice chat.

items.title: Lethal Algorithm
items.desc: Lethal Algorithm is a VR multiplayer game with voice chat that I worked on as hobby as I have always wanted to experience piloting a mecha from inside the cockpit in VR.

items.title: VR Real Time Strategy (RTS)
items.desc: A VR realtime strategy game mode for Homaysa that allows the users to control their army in Virtual Reality.

items.title: VR Horror Dungeon Crawler - Escape the room style
items.desc: A VR dungeon crawler horror / puzzle / escape the room type of game mode/experience for users of Homaysa.

items.title: VR Shooting Game Modes
items.desc: VR shooting ranges open and closed. These are game modes I made for Homaysa.

items.title: VR Spaceship Simulation
items.desc: VR spaceship simulation game mode where users can pilot a spaceship in a zero-gravity experience. Built as a multiplayer VR game mode for Homaysa.

items.title: PWC VR Game mode
items.desc: VR personal watercraft (jet-ski) simulation game mode in Unreal Engine 5 featuring water buoyancy physics and first-person handlebars locomotion.

items.title: VR Sports Simulations
items.desc: Worked on many VR sports simulations game modes like Baseball, Chess, Go, Billiard.

items.title: WaterSim - Satellite Data Visualization
items.desc: Joined the 11th CASSINI Hackathon. Created a VR/Unity simulation for satellite data visualization of water floods and pollution in Den Haag.

items.title: AR Business Card Logo
items.desc: AR business card logo built using Unity and the EasyAR SDK.

items.title: Augmented Reality (AR) for a Business Card
items.desc: Interactive AR hologram for Gamified Labs business cards. Tapping the virtual button on the card projects a 3D hologram of the company logo.

items.title: Augmented Reality Space Door/Portal (AR)
items.desc: Augmented Reality portal installation built with Unity and Apple ARKit at Gamified Labs, allowing mall visitors to step through a virtual doorway onto the Moon.

items.title: Sensor-Free AR/VR Property Tour
items.desc: An innovative real estate marketing app developed in 2017 that leverages ARKit for sensor-free tracking, allowing users to seamlessly transition from AR to VR with a single click.

items.title: AR Tracking
items.desc: An interactive Augmented Reality (AR) application featuring real-time human foot tracking and physics engine integration to simulate digital object interaction (football) with the user's physical body.

items.title: True Horror: Mobile Horror/Puzzle Game
items.desc: First-person horror and puzzle game for iOS and Android built in Unity. Set inside a haunted family home afflicted by a demonic presence, combining atmospheric tension with environmental puzzles.

items.title: Lost In Nightmares: Android Horror / Puzzle Game
items.desc: My first commercial release on Google Play for Android—a first-person horror and puzzle adventure built in Unity.

items.title: Get Rich: 2D Android & iOS game
items.desc: Become the RICHEST!

items.title: 2D Platform Game
items.desc: 2D platformer game where the alien character must return to space. Made using Unity3D. It was developed by me and another Unity developer. It was made in a few days. Player can control objects in front of the character with the mouse before the character reach it.

items.title: AI Made Game: 2D Submarine Simulation
items.desc: Have you ever seen a game that is almost 100% made by AI 🤖To test the true power of LLMs, I decided to build and publish a complete web based 2D game from scratch in less than a month.

items.title: Herds: RTS PC Game
items.desc: Real-Time Strategy (RTS) PC game built in Unity (URP). Our zombie finds himself in a town filled with humans and just wants one bite—infecting townspeople to dynamically grow and command an expanding zombie horde.

items.title: "The" Savior: a Game jam game
items.desc: A hero with two consciences fighting inside her—who wins, who loses? You decide. Co-op dual-controller game jam prototype where two players share triggers and thumbsticks to control one character.

items.title: Blindwaves: A Game Jam Game
items.desc: A 2017 Global Game Jam entry integrating Keijiro Takahashi's wave shader: play as a blind protagonist who can only see echolocation sound waves while evading enemies.

items.title: Unity DOTS/ECS City
items.desc: An experimental Real-Time Strategy (RTS) prototype developed in 2020 to explore Unity's Data-Oriented Technology Stack (DOTS) and Entity Component System (ECS). The core gameplay revolved around a dynamic day-and-night cycle where players strategically organized and managed their own protests. Although it showcased promising mechanics, the project was ultimately archived; the early DOTS framework was highly unstable at the time, with frequent crashes and rapidly shifting APIs that made sustained development impractical.

items.title: Soul Game
items.desc: A 2019 Global Game Jam game made to resemble a Dark Souls game. Made in 2 days only. For the water I made my own shader in Unity.

items.title: Space Fight: 2D WebGL Browser Game
items.desc: A 2D space fighting game. It runs on the browser using WebGL.
